date_note: The article gives only its own publication day (23 November, CT Insider via GovTech).
title: Connecticut Senate Democratic leaders plan hearing on how utilities guard against cyberattacks
impact: Planned informational hearing; no date set.
summary: Incoming Connecticut Senate Democratic leaders Bob Duff and Gary Winfield plan to call the state's electric, natural gas and water utilities to testify in the 2027 session, CT Insider reports. Lawmakers want to know how utilities guard against cyberattacks, what backups they have and how they would restore service. No date is set.
plain: Connecticut lawmakers plan a hearing next year asking power, gas and water utilities how they defend against cyberattacks and restore service.
exec: Utilities in Connecticut may face questions from lawmakers in 2027 about cyber defences and recovery plans.
